body:

## Current PM

⏳ **vacant** · the previous seat `session_01CinRQcE6T8SvMbhH8D3NhS` (huangyiirene) signed off 2026-10-12T11:36Z on the maintainer's instruction 「当前任务处理完,合并后就下班」(2026-10-12T09:59Z, this seat's chat); the 收班简报 is the comment that follows this body and is the release marker. Patrol Routine `trig_01EX1gU7pjEcXx3RuiZ4wAsS` deleted at sign-off. No 留守: nothing of this seat's is in flight or in a landing window. Successor: `/pm-dispatch skills` in a fresh session; first readings = `check-harness-current.mjs` (SKILL.md moved to `67baccc55` this shift), this body, the brief, then the lane inventory on both boards. ## Inherited + running ledger

- **Maintainer rulings this shift (chat, verbatim selections; recorded on the cards):** ① 「A:只删 id(推荐)」 → objectui#12202; ② 「不加,写成文规则(推荐)」 → the AGENTS.md rule in objectui#12202 + objectstack's id-lint widened to `skills/**` in #22983; ③ 「B2:扩 doc-json 门禁一条腿(推荐)」 → objectui#12204. All three landed.
- **Queue (`pm:queue` ∩ `domain:skills`):** objectstack 1 — #22340 (`pm:queue` + `pm:retriage`: the cloud test-helper residue needs a lane that reaches the cloud repository; ⛔ not claimable until retriage answers; `Release:` `6123458126`) · objectui 0.
- **In flight 0.** **Landing windows 0.** **Decision box 0** · `pm:awaiting-maintainer` 0 · `pm:on-hold` 0 · bare `finding` 0 · `tracking` 2: #22060, #17161.
- **Maintainer-driven lane card:** #22998 (p1, two-speed CI; `pm:dispatched`, assignee `os-zhuang`, director seat dispatching on the maintainer's order) — not a lane seat's to touch; its `AGENTS.md` regions are the merge-queue paragraph and the gates section.
- **`pm:blocked` 2:** #22585 (`Blocked-by: #19939`, open; the line lives in the transition comment `6093086948`, not the body — pre-existing half-state, the successor's first write) · #22978 (p1 ADR sweep for #15204's stage 8; `Blocked-by: #22900`; S8 has no PR yet; transition `6120290870`).
- **Corrections on the record this shift:** 「the retire needs no checker edit」 (#22869) → #22987; 「0 issue-id hits in objectstack `skills/**`」 (#22983) was the seat's instrument misfiring — 2 CSS colours; 「one line can carry the exception」 (#22979) falsified by the 120-byte cap; the objectui#12204 dispatch did not name `markdown-test-inputs.test.ts` as a gate for a change to a test's markdown read set (one red CI cycle) and inverted the gate's anchor — corrected on the tree by the dev.
- **Carried, still open:** NOT MEASURED — the first pull changing `.github/workflows/**` the relay enqueues with the widened token; the first Version Packages PR re-stamping the ten skill frontmatters (`@objectstack/skills` owes a patch from PR #23011). Acceptance notes (not cards): the coverage.json picklist waiver is stale beyond #22869; `check-platform-checklist`'s active-rule refusal advertises an element-type check it does not perform; `lint.yml`'s comment above the id-lint step is stale; `scripts/adr-anchors/…metadata-plugin.zod.ts.json` cites ADR-0005 lines 53–64 which PR #23011's note shifts by two.

## Notes

- Job description and write paths: `references/lanes/skills.md`; content writes only through `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` / `label-write.mjs` / `issue-create.mjs` / `close-cards.mjs` and `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`; route `dispatch` (relay); ⛔ no MCP write. Landing shapes: r177 and #19287 r14 Notes stand; measured this shift — relay `automerge_enable` on a ready, approved, fully-green objectui PR enqueued it within a minute (`added_to_merge_queue`), with `auto_merge` on the PR object staying `null`.
- Harness readings: `check-harness-current.mjs` CURRENT at `246edf5b39` at seating; `SKILL.md` moved to `67baccc55` (PR #22997) during the shift; `references/` `048f3891e`, `lanes/skills.md` `0bc46c6d1`, `os-dev.md` `73d700188`; `AGENTS.md` moved by PR #23011 (`e4a770d6b`) and by #22998 when it lands.
- Platform readings this shift: the auto-mode classifier refuses, as `[Self-Modification]`, the seat's own relay stroke that flips/enqueues a PR changing `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, and refused the dev's Edit on the same file — a Tier S landing on that file is a human's until a settings rule says otherwise; `check-expected-skips.mjs` needs `yaml`, absent from the shared checkout's empty `node_modules` — a copy at `/home/user/node_modules/yaml` resolves for the ESM lookup; `post-stamped` refuses a bare stamp beside `{{NOW}}` anywhere in the body (quote readings as `{{WAS:…}}`) and a `Thread-read:` value with anything after the id; parallel Bash calls in one turn share the shell's working directory — use `git -C` and absolute paths; a zero reading needs a positive control on the same instrument; `[.[].id]|last` over one 100-comment page is not the newest comment on a long thread — read with `since=`; `GET /search/issues` and GraphQL answer 403 for a repo-bound session — inventory with `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues?labels=` per board; the Actions job-log blob redirect is refused through the proxy — read logs with the MCP `get_job_logs` read tool; both `main` rulesets keep approvals across pushes and need no last-push approval (`required_approving_review_count` 0; the governed gate is `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`, not the ruleset).
- Timers and subscriptions at sign-off: none (Routine deleted; every PR subscription closed by merge).
